paper.title: Prompt a Robot to Walk with Large Language Models
paper.central_claim: 用从物理环境收集的少样本提示（描述提示+历史观测动作），现成 LLM（GPT-4）无需微调即可作为低层反馈控制器自回归输出目标关节位置，让机器人行走；在不同机器人、地形与仿真器上验证。

provenance.notes: anchors_version=v2 (3ececdd11cc3d144); phase=production; session_id/receipt_ref not self-obtainable by worker (null); expectations_hash = sha256 of concatenated patterns/main/*.md (expectations embedded there, no standalone file); domain_cards_hash = sha256(research/patterns/taxonomy.json); patterns/overview.md sha256=2bc4cdeb322e2c8ed96598feb5c4867b858f48b6bf9efa0eb29943735d84cdcf.

evidence.quote: enabling the LLM to autoregressively generate low-level control commands for robots without task-specific fine-tuning
evidence.support_explanation: 中心主张：现成 LLM 凭少样本提示自回归输出低层控制，无需微调。

evidence.quote: Our main contribution is a framework for prompting a robot to walk with LLMs, where LLMs act as a feedback policy rather than a planner as is common in recent work.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者主张的贡献形态：LLM 作反馈策略。

evidence.quote: We do one-time initialization of the prompt based on an existing controller, which could be either model-based or learning-based.
evidence.support_explanation: 提示用已有控制器(此处为 PPO RL 策略)的观测-动作对一次性初始化。

evidence.quote: the initial offline data will be replaced by LLM outputs
evidence.support_explanation: 约 5 秒历史后上下文只含 LLM 自身输出。

evidence.quote: The output of the LLM is the target joint positions, which are tracked by a set of joint Proportional-Derivative (PD) controllers running at a higher frequency.
evidence.support_explanation: 输出目标关节位置，由 200Hz PD 跟踪：这是该"harness"的执行控制层。

evidence.quote: Our LLM policy operates at 10 Hz [ 11 ] and is then tracked by a low-level joint PD controller at 200 Hz.
evidence.support_explanation: 10Hz LLM 策略+200Hz PD。

evidence.quote: we found that only GPT-4 is powerful enough to in-context learn a robot walking behavior using our designed prompt
evidence.support_explanation: 仅 GPT-4 可行；其他模型无数值。

evidence.quote: we set GPT-4’s temperature to 0 to minimize the variance
evidence.support_explanation: 温度 0。

evidence.quote: The success rate is measured by the percentage of the trials that the robot is able to finish, where each trial lasts for 10 seconds, and we have 5 trials for each experiment.
evidence.support_explanation: 成功判据（10 秒不摔）与分母（每设置 5 次）。

evidence.quote: without a description prompt (E1), there is a minimal likelihood of LLMs prompting a robot to walk
evidence.support_explanation: 去掉描述提示后几乎不能走。

evidence.quote: It is evident that increased length of observations and actions correlate with enhanced performance, both in terms of normalized walking time and success rate.
This form of control was insufficient for successfully making the robot walk in the experiment
evidence.support_explanation: 仅动作无观测(开环)失败，是对"纯回放"替代解释的部分检验。
数值归一化对比：成功率 0.0/0.0/0.6/0.2/0.6（5 次试验，单位标注为 % 但数值为分数，按分数读）。

evidence.quote: With the proposed text prompt, we successfully prompt the ANYmal robot to walk on flat ground.
evidence.support_explanation: 第二种本体(ANYmal，Isaac Gym)仅定性成功。

evidence.quote: this leads to a walking gait that becomes reasonably worse compared to many RL-based walking policies running at 50 Hz or even higher
evidence.support_explanation: 步态质量弱于 RL；无定量对比。

evidence.quote: Although the LLM policy is initialized with the RL policy, the resulting joint trajectories are noticeably different.
evidence.support_explanation: 与 RL 轨迹不同，作者据此推断"不同于行为克隆的 in-context learning"。

evidence.quote: First, the current prompt design is fragile. Minor alterations in the prompt can dramatically affect the walking performance
evidence.support_explanation: 提示脆弱。

evidence.quote: our prompt design inevitably becomes biased toward this policy
evidence.support_explanation: 提示设计偏向初始化策略。

evidence.quote: Another major limitation is that we are only able to carry out simulation experiments instead of hardware experiments.
evidence.support_explanation: 仅仿真，无真机。

evidence.quote: we have to pause the simulation to wait for the output of GPT-4
evidence.support_explanation: 仿真需暂停等待 GPT-4，非实时。

evidence.quote: this work was expensive and roughly costed
evidence.support_explanation: 约 2000 美元 API 费用（原文含 $ 符号）。

evidence.quote: the LLM token consumption is approximately 348,1738,4518 , and 7298 tokens, respectively
evidence.support_explanation: 历史长度 0/10/30/50 的 token 数。

evidence.quote: [ 26 ] instructs LLMs as general pattern machines and demonstrates a stabilizing controller for a cartpole
evidence.support_explanation: 最近邻：LLM 作 pattern machine 控制 cartpole。

evidence.quote: [ 47 ] trains a specialized GPT model using robot data to make a robot walk
evidence.support_explanation: 最近邻：用机器人数据训练专用 GPT。

evidence.quote: the LLM policy operates with an observation space of 33 dimensions, whereas the RL policy uses 48 dimensions
evidence.support_explanation: LLM 用 33 维观测，RL 用 48 维。

evidence.quote: Thus, we believe that LLMs in-context learn differently to enable a robot to walk.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者对机制的解释，仅依据轨迹形状。

signatures.object: 低层反馈策略：冻结 GPT-4 取代 RL 神经网络策略，输出目标关节位置
signatures.information: 文本提示=描述部分(任务、输入输出含义、关节顺序、控制管线、补充说明)+最近 50 步归一化整数的观测(33 维)与动作；初始历史来自 PPO RL 策略；LLM 见不到仿真特权量之外的东西，无未来信息
signatures.operation: 自回归生成下一时刻归一化目标关节位置（0-200 整数），经反归一化送 PD
signatures.conditions: GPT-4、温度 0、10Hz、8k token 上下文；仿真需暂停等待
signatures.feedback: 新观测+上一步动作追加进滚动历史
signatures.persistence: 上下文窗口为滚动状态；无跨试验记忆
signatures.later_use: 下一步 LLM 推理读取更新后的历史
signatures.claimed_effect: A1 可在 10 秒内不摔(完整描述提示成功率 0.6/5 次)，也可在崎岖地形恢复；ANYmal 平地成功
signatures.failure_boundary: 仅 GPT-4 可行；提示脆弱；偏向初始化策略；仅仿真；步态差于 RL

signatures.object: 数值到文本的接口：线性映射为 0-200 非负整数使每个值成单 token
signatures.information: 原始浮点/负值观测与动作
signatures.operation: 归一化为单 token 整数表示
signatures.conditions: GPT-4 对 [-300,300] 整数单 token
signatures.selection_rule: 5 种归一化方式对比，选最优
signatures.claimed_effect: 成功率 0.6(整数归一化) vs 0.0(原值)
signatures.failure_boundary: Table I 在紧凑观测与 20 秒设置下完成，与主设置不同

gap.author_gap: LLM 多用作高层规划；落地到物理世界、生成动态机器人运动困难；机器人基础模型需要稀缺的机器人数据。作者提问：现成 LLM 能否无训练地充当高维系统的低层控制器。
gap.checked_gap: gap 的概念性成立（E023/E024 给出近邻），但其实际价值论证薄：10Hz、需暂停仿真、花费约 2000 美元、步态弱于 RL（E015,E020,E021）；未说明相对 RL/MPC 的收益场景。

G.reason: 存在概念性空白（现成 LLM 作高维低层反馈控制器，近邻为 cartpole pattern machines 与专用 GPT），但对实用瓶颈的论证薄（慢、贵、劣于 RL），最近邻比较仅文字，残余问题与利害边界不清。

M.reason: 有具体机制（描述提示提供语义语境、历史提供动力学反馈、整数归一化使单 token）并有组件消融支持；但"LLM 推断动力学"的核心假设只靠轨迹形状论证，周期性模式续写等替代解释未检验。

holdout.reason: 无训练/测试划分；提示在 A1 上设计并偏向初始化策略；第二本体仅定性、无计数，不符合 transfer。

statistics.reason: 每设置 5 次试验、无方差；失败仅在局限段落定性提及。
